newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Banerj auction to be held Dec 26.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Banerj auction to be held Dec 26.

text.p: The privatization of Brazil's Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj will be held on December 26, said a spokeswoman from the state planning ministry.
"The auction will now take place on December 26 at 1600 local (1800 GMT)," the spokeswoman said.
Banerj had been due to be sold off on December 17 but the sale was postponed late December 16 after a court issued an injunction that blocked the sale.
Since early January, Bozano, Simonsen, a private bank, has managed Banerj and helped prepare for its selloff on behalf of the central bank.
The central bank took over Banerj in December 1994. It initially was authorized to run the bank for one year but its administration was extended for 12 more months.
Under the current legislation, the central bank's management cannot be extended again unless the government issues a decree.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
